summary.name: Meridian Strategy Audit
summary.certificate_scope: Operational tests of this policy portfolio, sampled maps, horizons and input rates; not a proof of strategic depth or distinct human metas.

config.name: Meridian Strategy Audit
config.search: open-loop portfolio UCT; independent hidden-state priors; no learned network

tests.label: Same 8s thinking + repeated commands vs no repeats

warnings: Underperforming tested policies (below 40% opponent-weighted wins): guards. The diversity gate needs several viable policies; it does not mean every playstyle is competitive.
93.6% of counted victories are space launches. Military pressure may be feeding a space race rather than supporting an independent conquest route; inspect captures and the multiplayer endings.

34/1807 resolved experiments reached the 2,200-second diagnostic cap without a legal victory. They are stalls, not draws or wins; inspect blocked routes, passive policies and delayed space development.
Same policy: 2s vs 8s: fast/repeated-input side wins 51.9%; input penalty 1.9 percentage points above 50%. Evidence is not yet decisive; see the interval.
Fewer than one city capture per completed match on average: conquest is uncommon in this portfolio.
No tested position demonstrates a delayed ranking reversal with a tangible consequence. Long-term depth is not established.
A reliable advantage from additional thinking has not been established at every tested budget step. Inspect sample size, search horizon, evaluator and action coverage before blaming the rules.
